purpose: prepare typed inputs for B07A source-hardware realization and B07B true-reference hidden-parameter recovery

candidate_ref.reason: fresh T1 package and exact G1/G2/G3 join required

mission_ref.reason: mission and bounds must be frozen before result visibility

design_alternative_id.reason: design alternative is existential and must be explicit

solver_input_hashes.reason: generated only after provider match and frozen numerical configuration

provider_manifest_hashes.reason: UP2-05 provider identities are not available

target_field_or_observables.reason: include components, support, time and measurement/target distinction

target_coordinate_frame.reason: must include frame, basis, handedness and transform refs

source_basis_refs.reason: must be declared by G3; no hidden source basis

source_parameterization.reason: geometry/current/material/driver/return variables must be finite and typed

objective.reason: weights, norms, units, regularization and target provenance must be frozen before results

initialization_policy.reason: multi-start seeds may not contain hidden answers or held-out observations

uncertainty_policy.reason: parameter/data/model discrepancy must be represented or left unknown

independence_group.reason: forward checker and inverse executor roles must be independent as declared

protocol_id.reason: formal B07A protocol must be frozen before execution

b07a_source_hardware_realization.allowed_target: synthetic target field or source demand is allowed
required_inputs: independent forward checker and provider manifest

design_variables.name: coil_geometry
design_variables.reason: G3 and G2 geometry authority required

design_variables.name: cooling_and_support
design_variables.reason: cannot default to zero loss or infinite support

required_outputs: target and realized field error with units
all required scenario outcomes and evidence ceiling
b07a_source_hardware_realization.credit_boundary: B07A can support scoped R04/R05 engineering evidence only after its own gates; it never supplies R02 real-reference inverse credit

protocol_id.reason: formal B07B protocol must be frozen before execution

required_inputs: known observed quantities and explicit hidden parameter declaration
source-owned geometry/interior/boundary basis with coordinate and unit authority
forward model applicability and independent checker

parameter_values_in_input.reason: ground-truth answer must be withheld from initialization and cache

identifiability_scope.reason: report identifiable combinations or intervals when full recovery is nonunique

validation_ids.reason: must not overlap calibration or held-out

held_out_ids.reason: combination identity must differ; no one-column leakage

split.overlap_checker: must prove artifact, shot, scenario, topology and derived-array disjointness

required_outputs: posterior or uncertainty interval with data/model discrepancy
failure class and resolution for every missing or out-of-domain item
b07b_true_reference_hidden_parameter_rec.credit_boundary: B07B is the only branch eligible for R02 inverse credit, and only after true source provenance, identifiability and held-out evidence pass

objective_terms.unit: J or W with ledger scope

hard_constraints: R_circuit=0 per node and declared KVL/RL/protection
objective_and_constraints_template.static_emf_rule: static stationary flux does not become EMF; a derivative source, time grid, direction and uncertainty are mandatory

result_state_template.pending_rule: missing authority is unknown plus terminal_deferred; contradiction is fail_closed; no terminal unsupported or credible result may be emitted by this template
